description: The wet clock through saving and reopening (#720), seen in the dark scheme's replay of light / dark watercolour on a pixel layer: a document whose second stroke's pen lifted after the paint flowed on (`endStep`) and whose paint flowed on after its last stroke (`wet.clock`) is opened and replayed to both; saved and reopened it is the same; a stroke painted after opening goes on from the saved clock, and reopening that two-session document replays the dry its save did between the sessions; an older two-session document, whose second session's clocks start again at 0, is replayed in order.
